basics.name: Uran Maimekov
basics.label: PhD Candidate | Bioinformatics, Machine Learning, Cancer Genomics
basics.summary: PhD candidate in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology at Rutgers Health developing machine learning and statistical frameworks for cancer genomics, multi-omics integration, biomarker discovery, and treatment-response prediction. Experienced in bulk and single-cell transcriptomics, alternative splicing analysis, survival modeling, pathway enrichment, molecular machine learning, and reproducible computational workflows.

work.name: School of Graduate Studies, Rutgers Health
work.position: PhD Researcher, Bioinformatics and Computational Biology
work.summary: Develop machine learning and statistical methods for cancer genomics, multi-omics integration, biomarker discovery, and treatment-response prediction.
highlights: Developed computational frameworks for analyzing high-throughput cancer omics data, including transcriptomics and alternative splicing.
Integrated molecular interaction networks with machine learning models to identify candidate biomarkers of cancer progression and treatment response.
Performed pathway enrichment, survival analysis, and patient-stratification analyses across cancer cohorts.

work.name: Alma AI, Inc. startup company
work.summary: Fine-tune and evaluate protein language models (TxGemma) for therapeutic machine learning tasks.
highlights: Prepared biological sequence datasets for protein model fine-tuning and benchmarking.
Ran training and evaluation pipelines to assess model performance across therapeutic prediction tasks.
Analyzed model failure cases and proposed improvements to data processing, evaluation strategy, and predictive performance.

work.name: Johnson and Johnson (J&J)
work.summary: Conducted single-cell transcriptomic and co-expression analyses of inhibitory immune receptors across immunological disease contexts.
highlights: Analyzed single-cell RNA-seq datasets to characterize inhibitory immune receptor expression across immune cell populations.
Built co-expression analysis workflows to identify receptor-associated transcriptional programs.
Generated visualizations and biological interpretations supporting translational immunology research.

work.name: Ayil Bank
highlights: Crafted and implemented robust pipelines for streamlined data collection from bank databases using Python and SQL, ensuring reliable and efficient data integration
Developed PowerBI dashboards and reports for real-time data monitoring, significantly reducing data generation time to an hour and enhancing operational efficiency

projects.name: (Silver medal) NeurIPS 2024 BELKA — Molecular Binding Prediction
projects.summary: Kaggle solution for predicting small-molecule binding to protein targets using molecular representations and machine learning.
highlights: Modeled molecule-protein binding using SMILES-derived molecular features.
Used graph neural networks, molecular fingerprints, and ensemble learning approaches.
Designed validation strategy to reduce leakage and improve generalization across targets.

projects.name: (Bronze medal) CAFA 5 Protein Function Prediction
projects.summary: Kaggle solution for large-scale protein function prediction using protein language model embeddings and multi-label classification.
highlights: Used ESM-2 protein language model embeddings as sequence representations.
Built multi-label classifiers for Gene Ontology term prediction.
Applied ontology-aware post-processing using GO ancestor propagation.
